create_MujocoGymEnv: create a MujocoGymEnv instance from an XML path with custom seed and control timestep
create_FrankaGymEnv: create a FrankaGymEnv instance for a Franka Panda robot with image observations enabled
run_apply_action: run apply_action on a FrankaGymEnv to move the robot tcp and gripper via operational space control
test_get_robot_state: test get_robot_state on a FrankaGymEnv to retrieve qpos, qvel, gripper pose, and tcp position
review_render: review the render method on FrankaGymEnv to return multi-camera rgb frames from front and wrist cameras
